paragraphs: UrbanFix is a digital platform that enables citizens to report, track, and resolve city infrastructure issues such as broken streetlights, potholes, water leakage, garbage overflow, and damaged footpaths. The system ensures transparency, reduces response time, and improves city service delivery by connecting citizens, staff, and admins efficiently.
features: User-Friendly Interface: Responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop.
Issue Reporting: Citizens can submit issues with title, description, photo, location, and category.
Upvote System: Logged-in users can upvote issues to highlight public importance; users cannot upvote their own issues.
Timeline Tracking: Every issue has a timeline showing status updates, actions, and progress.
Boost Priority Feature: Citizens can boost issue priority after successful payment; boosted issues appear at the top.
